
 ◇ susynth › ? Help · ↑↓ PgUp PgDn scroll
 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

      PAGES                                                                                                 █
      m                      the pages pop-up beside the icons: ↑↓ choose, Enter open, m or Esc close       █
  ▶   In the editor on Play, m types the letter: press Esc m there.                                         █
  ≡   Esc f  /  Esc b        next / previous page                                                           █
  ●   Esc                    from any page, back to Play                                                    █
  ♪   For Esc keys, press Esc, then the key within 1.5 s, or hold Alt.                                      █
  ⚙   KEYS ON EACH PAGE                                                                                     █
  ?   Sets                   ↑↓ select · Enter load · a add to the set list · n new · d delete (asks        █
  ◈   first)                                                                                                │
  ▮   Recordings             ↑↓ select · Enter show the path · d delete (asks first)                        │
      Sounds                 ↑↓ select · ←→ fold a group · Enter preview or fold · i insert the example     │
      Settings               ↑↓ select · ←→ change · Enter edit or reload where it says so                  │
      Help                   ↑↓ PgUp PgDn scroll                                                            │
      Perform                Enter go live · i mix in · Esc n / Esc p next / previous · [ ] reorder · d     │
      remove                                                                                                │
                                                                                                            │
      PLAYING                                                                                               │
      ^E                     run the block under the cursor (the whole live_loop; ┊ marks it)               │
      Esc Enter              run the whole buffer, like Sonic Pi's Run                                      │
      ^G                     stop every live_loop and thread, like Sonic Pi's Stop                          │
      ^P                     stop, or run the whole buffer again                                            │
      ^R                     start / stop recording a WAV                                                   │
      ^S  ^O                 save / load a set by name (sets are .rb files)                                 │
      Esc u  n               mute / unmute track n — a digit alone does nothing                             │
      Esc k  n               stop that track (Enter stops the loop under the cursor)                        │
      Esc s  n               solo track n (0 clears)                                                        │
  ● play   ● 60 bpm · bar 1 · ●○○○   ○ rec off
  ↑↓ PgUp PgDn scroll   m pages   ^Q quit
